Bash(node -e "const d=require\('fs'\).readFileSync\('/dev/stdin','utf8'\); const j=JSON.parse\(d\); console.log\('Action:', j.transaction.summary\); console.log\('USDC before:', j.state_change.before.USDC, '→ after:', j.state_change.after.USDC\)")
